hook: Temu's real trick was *one parcel* at a time
paragraphs: Why was Temu so cheap? Not just the factories or the ads. The real trick was the parcel.
A US customs rule called de minimis let any shipment under {eight hundred dollars|$800}, sent to one person, come in with no duties.
A store importing ten thousand phone cases in a container pays duty on all of them. Ten thousand separate parcels? No duty.
So every Temu order flew alone, straight from China. In fiscal 2024, US customs handled {one point three six billion|1.36B} of these parcels. About {three point seven million|3.7M} a day.
Then the door closed: in {May 2025|May 2025} for China, and in {August 2025|Aug. 2025} for everyone.
So can Temu survive? Full story on the channel.
